item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Ahoy there, pvm08. Greetings and welcome to the SCP Wiki!

My name is Hexick, and I'm a Junior Staff member on the site's CO team, and a (sometimes) author. Since you're interested in becoming an author on the Wiki, I highly recommend you go about reading through some of the newer articles available to get a feel for what types of content the community is currently interested in. I personally suggest checking out SCP-5057. Not only that, but if you're interested in talking with members of the community to become acquainted, it would be a good idea to go about joining our IRC chatrooms. Anyway, here are some resources to help you get started:

◎ Open Resources ◎
◉ Close Resources ◉

If you're going to try your hand at writing, try out our sandbox. You can make yourself a page here to store your drafts.

Sandbox

For hashing out concepts, try out the Ideas and Brainstorming forum. You can run your ideas by the community if you need help refining your concept.

If you have a draft ready, make a thread in the Drafts and Critiques forum. Remember to check the stickied posts in the relevant thread for guidelines on how best to use each forum. You can also try the IRC chat for real-time feedback.

From site usage to writing tips, the Guide Hub contains a wealth of resources geared towards helping members produce successful articles.

The more time you take to familiarize yourself with the SCP style, the drafting process, and the community, the greater your chances are for success!

As far as reading is concerned, you might want to check out our Top Rated New Pages, which will display the most popular, recent articles. It's helpful to keep up with what's being received well by the community.

With that said, I hope you enjoy your time here, and if you have any questions or concerns, feel free to contact myself or another member of CO Staff via Wikidot or IRC.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello hello JackrawTheWriter! Welcome to the Wiki! I'm Ralliston, a site author and a member of the Community Outreach Team - with this helpful little comment, I'll try to help you find your way around the site and link a bunch of useful places and links that will help you in your SCP journey.

It's awesome you finally decided to make an account - after all, only by voting, which only people with one can, can you actively affect the quality of works posted onsite. I'm also happy to see you quite want to contribute, too - I can't wait to see what you come up with, I'm sure it will be awesome!

Without further ado though, let's click the collapsible, shall we? :)

+ show block
– hide block

If you're going to try your hand at writing, try out our Sandbox. You can make yourself a page here to store your drafts, which are in-works articles. Using it, you can link the drafts to reviewers to get their opinions on them before posting. It really helps everyone out a lot.

For brainstorming concepts, try out the Ideas and Brainstorming forum. You can run your ideas by experienced members of the community if you need help refining and fleshing out your concept. It's a very helpful little place for when you want to start your writing journey, especially when you're not sure if the idea is all that great.

If you have a draft ready, make a thread in the Drafts and Critiques forum. Remember to check the stickied posts in the relevant thread for guidelines on how best to use each forum. You can also try the IRC chat for real-time feedback.

From site usage to writing tips, the Guide Hub contains a wealth of resources geared towards helping members produce successful articles. Within the Guides, you will find useful information written by experienced members of the site for the use of newer ones.

The more time you take to familiarize yourself with the SCP style, the drafting process, and the community, the greater your chances are for success! Remember - there is no rush to writing - take your time! The more time you spend on fleshing your ideas out, the more your chance of success becomes!

As far as reading is concerned, you might want to check out Top Rated New Pages, which will display the most popular recent articles. It's helpful to keep up with what's being received well by the community to implement into your very own writing. Alternatively, you might want to look at the User Curated Lists page, where members of the community list and rank their favorite articles in different genres and themes, showing which attempts at such are successful and what the community likes.

Best of luck with your future contributions to the site! I hope you enjoy your time here as much as we do! If you have any more questions, feel free to message me here on Wikidot or on the IRC chats!

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers
item.content:encoded:
Hello folks, I am TruckRail82. I have been a lurker on the wiki for about 1 and a half years now, just reading articles and tales. I actually did join last month, but was kept busy by real life obligations. I figured it might be worthwhile to actually contribute to here, and to develop my English writing skills as a result. I do not have any ideas for SCPs as such, but who knows, I might be inspired one random day.

As for how I got into the wiki, well, one of my IRL friends introduced me to SCP:CB back when we were in uni and had a carp ton(typo intentional) of free time, and I found this site had a lot more of where those came from.
To answer the QotM, I am actually a good sleeper, so if there is something that does keep me awake, its probably some kind of feverish delusions.
Cheers, and I hope I can meet some cool people!

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello SCP Wiki Forums!

I've recently taken an interest in this place when SCP animation videos started showing up in my YouTube feed, particularly ones from the spin-off channel of the Infographics channel. Technically, I've known about the existence of SCPs since around 2014, courtesy of Tumblr, but I've never really thought of actually trying to write stories set in the SCP Universe until now.

Right now, I have a weird idea for an SCP based around the tragedy of Actaeon, that curses those who activate it with Cervocephaly (deer headedness) and causes all dogs nearby to want to kill them, and I'm already starting to think up a narrative for its discovery by the Foundation. It's sort of festive, since it is the time of year for (sleigh pulling) deer after all, and maybe if I'm lucky I'll at least have a draft published in my sandbox before Christmas.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Hey!

My name's Shuu (he/him), I like games and I'm a university student completely unsure of what he's doing with his life!
I've been a lurker of texts here for quite a while actually, but decided that I wanted to give some +1's to all those entries that made me feel stuff (from getting scared of damn text to completely breaking me) because I feel like it's the least I can do for all the good times I've had trying to discover what's each entry about. All the twists and stories behind and how they intertwine with others… So looking forward for more of that, and maybe discussing with people here about it!

And for what thoughts keep me up at night… It's usually whatever I saw last before going to bed. That being the ending of a movie or game (and what happens in the future of that universe, like with FF7). Or sometimes what the cats outside my window are doing.
I swear I can hear them scheming something.

So yeah, glad to be here!

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hi there! I've been consuming SCP-related content for a while and have found that it really resonates with my tastes in fiction. I'm excited to contribute to such an incredible community!

I've yet to find an SCP article I haven't enjoyed to some extent, but I've particularly enjoyed SCPs that are locations (SCP-3008, SCP-087) or resemble humans (SCP-049, SCP-1788). I'm also a big fan of seemingly innocuous and mundane objects that have anomalous attributes. I'd love some suggestions of articles to check out, whether they're similar to the above or not!

Thanks for having me! I'm looking forward to collaborating with the awesome folks here.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hi everyone!

For quite some time i was reading articles in this website and thought of joining the community and maybe add something from my own.

I am a new writer and don't have much experience but i hope i will get that experience as i read more and will be able to create my own work in the and with things i learned from everyone here.

I like mystery and SCP's that are hard to understand or has a deeper story than it looks like. I also like stories and articles that connect each other and make a lore of itself. This is something i also want to write about and i hope i will make a good SCP with that concept in the future.

Thank you for giving me this opportunity, and it is a pleasure to meet you all.
